name: extract-public-bodies

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
for stem in ['simion','subgroup']:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout',f'sources/{stem}.pdf','-'],text=True,capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
 w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),f'sources/{stem}.txt'],input=r.stdout,text=True,capture_output=True);assert w.returncode==0
 print(stem,'length',len(r.stdout));print(r.stdout if stem=='simion' else r.stdout[:19000])
